purpose: Diagnose the boundary/voxel-staircase discretization sensitivity of the PFFDTD dense sub-band worsening pattern: vary only the PFFDTD cartesian boundary/staircase representation (the bn_ixyz boundary-node set and the adj_bn blocked-neighbor mask inside vox_out.h5) under the same frozen solver contract, and record whether the 34-frequency worsening pattern moves. Predeclared verbatim by docs/R130D_GENERAL3D_STENCIL_SENSITIVITY_RESULT_2026-10-03.md as the next pre-fixed numerical experiment.

run76_record_binding.binding_rule: the canonical boundary cell evaluates the same persisted pressure/source records as authoritative run #76; a run that re-executes the pinned PFFDTD contract binds to those records by comparing the semantic sha256 of the recombined pressure trace and the unit discrete volume-velocity impulse source trace at every predeclared PPW level; variant cells are new executions and carry their own recorded trace digests
run76_record_binding.on_nonidentical: the computed sweep values are still emitted, but evaluation_state becomes NOT_EVALUATED_RECORD_BINDING_MISMATCH and the frozen classification is withheld so the result cannot be read as the run-76 experiment

voxel_staircase_sensitivity.axis: boundary/voxel-staircase discretization sensitivity: vary only the PFFDTD cartesian boundary/staircase representation inside vox_out.h5 — the bn_ixyz boundary-node set and the adj_bn six-direction blocked-neighbor mask; geometry, cartesian grid, source/receiver stencils and injected signals, materials, time sampling, duration, and the scored contract are unchanged

boundary_variants.rule: the exact executed (bn_ixyz, adj_bn) boundary representation recorded in the canonical leg's vox_out.h5; this is the control cell that binds the run-76 records

one-cell inward dilation of the staircase: every grid node that is an open-direction neighbor of at least one canonical boundary node, is not itself a canonical boundary node, and does not lie on the absorbing-boundary halo layer (any axis index 0 or N-1) is appended to bn_ixyz; each appended node inherits, verbatim, the adjacency row of the lowest-linear-index canonical boundary node it neighbors; appended rows are ordered by ascending linear index and carry the canonical rigid material marker for mat_bn and saf_bn=0.0; canonical boundary rows and all other datasets are unchanged — the effective staircase is displaced up to one cell into the air domain

drop every canonical boundary node whose adjacency row has zero open directions (the fully-blocked too-near-boundary nodes produced by the voxelizer near-hit rule); each dropped node leaves the boundary set and reverts to the plain-air interior update; remaining boundary rows keep their canonical adjacency and order

every canonical boundary node keeps its index but its adjacency row is set to all-open (all six directions adjacent); boundary nodes then update with the full six-neighbor Laplacian identical to interior air, so the staircase applies no boundary condition — the maximal-release bracket of the representation

every canonical boundary node keeps its index but its adjacency row is set to fully-blocked (zero open directions); boundary nodes then decouple from all neighbors in the leapfrog update — the maximal-confinement bracket of the representation

execution.variant_rule: re-execute the pinned PFFDTD SimEngine on a byte-copied sim asset set (vox_out.h5, comms_out.h5, sim_consts.h5, sim_mats.h5) with only the vox_out.h5 bn_ixyz/adj_bn arrays (and, where a variant appends boundary nodes, the correspondingly extended mat_bn/saf_bn rows and the Nb scalar) rewritten by the variant rule; the source/receiver comms authority and solver constants are byte-identical to the canonical leg, so injected signals, receiver sample contract, cartesian axes, dimensions, spacing, sound speed, time step, CFL lambdas, duration, and materials are unchanged
execution.canonical_cell_rule: reuse the canonical leg outputs that bind run76_record_binding
execution.contract_invariant: per variant run, comms_out.h5 datasets in_ixyz/in_sigs/out_ixyz/out_alpha/Ns/Nr/Nt and sim_consts.h5 datasets c/h/Ts/l/l2 and vox_out.h5 datasets xv/yv/zv/h/Nx/Ny/Nz must equal the canonical leg values; the semantic sha256 of each set is recorded and must match
execution.domain_invariant: per variant run, the mutated (bn_ixyz, adj_bn) must keep every source-stencil node reachable inside the connected air domain under the frozen six-direction adjacency (connected_air_domain_node_metrics); a variant that disconnects the source stencil blocks the diagnostic as fail-closed

rejected_axes.reason: the bound spatial-representation diagnostic already proves blocked-edge symmetry in the executed canonical data (a boundary pair whose reverse direction is open raises ValidationBlocked), so a symmetrization variant is degenerate by construction

the frozen fixture is rigid-only: the leapfrog boundary update reads saf_bn/mat_bn only for lossy (mat_bn>-1) nodes, which the rigid room does not contain; such variants are exact no-ops by construction

rejected_axes.axis: cartesian grid phase re-registration (translating the model against the fixed grid)
rejected_axes.reason: moves the pinned source/receiver positions and the fixture in absolute coordinates, which the frozen solver contract binds verbatim

evaluation.frequency_grid_ref: the dense_frequency_neighborhood band grid of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan (34 frequencies, 36.0-44.0/76.0-84.0 Hz at 0.5 Hz)
evaluation.worsening_rule: worsening at frequency f iff d_10_12(f) > d_8_10(f); the complete predeclared grid is evaluated for every cell with no post-result selection

per_cell_classification.rule: the dense worsening-count thresholds of the bound parent dense diagnostic plan applied to each cell independently

evaluation.pattern_metric: per-cell 34-frequency worsening vector compared to the canonical cell's vector; hamming_distance = count of frequencies whose worsening bit differs

classification.rule: invariant iff every evaluated non-canonical cell reproduces the canonical cell's worsening vector exactly; reclassified iff any evaluated non-canonical cell's dense classification differs from the canonical cell's; otherwise shifted
